lessons.correction: Maintain your current production and economy, and continue developing your technology. Keep your ground army strong.
lessons.mistake: Focusing solely on strengthening your ground army and continuing economy without advancing your technology, risking falling behind in tech and being vulnerable to warp prism harass.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.
lessons.title: Keep pace with opponent's tech while maintaining ground strength
lessons.when: Midgame, around 480 seconds, when you have a ground army with Zerglings and Queens, heavy production but moderate technology, and the opponent shows a ground posture with Stalkers, Sentries, and Warp Prisms.
lessons.why: The opponent's heavy tech and production require you to keep pace. Maintaining a solid economy and production will allow you to tech up without falling behind.

lessons.correction: Increase your economy and technology, continue expanding and producing. Strengthen your ground army further.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting economy or upgrades, or overcommitting to a single attack if the opponent is defending well, while only focusing on strengthening ground forces.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.
lessons.title: Balance economy, tech, and ground strength in late midgame
lessons.when: Late midgame, around 600-720 seconds, when you have a ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens, heavy production and technology, and the opponent shows a ground posture with Zealots, Stalkers, and Sentries.
lessons.why: The opponent's composition is strong on the ground, so you need to maintain a powerful ground force and tech to counter their upgrades.

lessons.correction: Increase your economy and technology, continue expanding and producing. Strengthen your ground army and prepare for air threats.
lessons.mistake: Ignoring the air threat and overcommitting to ground units without anti-air support, while focusing on strengthening ground and increasing economy.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of heavy air commitment.
lessons.title: Prepare anti-air while maintaining ground and economy
lessons.when: Midgame, around 420 seconds, when you have a ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens, moderate production but heavy technology, and the opponent shows an air posture with Void Rays and Oracles.
lessons.why: The opponent's air composition requires you to tech into anti-air units while maintaining a strong economy.
